update.title: GlassFolio {{version}} is available
update.body: GlassFolio will download the new version, install it and restart. Your data stays exactly where it is.
update.bodyManual: This installation updates from the download page. Open it to get the new version.

errors.verification: The downloaded file did not pass its integrity check, so nothing was installed. You can get the new version from the download page.
errors.generic: The update could not be installed. You can get the new version from the download page.

status.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
status.error: The check failed. Make sure you are online and try again.
status.errorSignature: The update information could not be verified, so it was ignored.
status.disabled: Updates are not available in this build.

autoCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
autoCheck.hint: Looks for a new version when GlassFolio starts and every few hours. It only asks GitHub for the latest release, so GitHub sees your IP address like for any web request; nothing about you or your data is sent. Nothing is installed without your click.
